status.description: Status is the current status of the Authenticator.

Authenticator.title: Authenticator
Authenticator.description: Authenticator is registered by a User and used for multi-factor authentication (MFA), for the re-authentication of an existent Session, or for a direct passwordless login via a Passkey.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the Authenticator's display name that the User sees

state.title: State
state.description: State is the state of the Authenticator

userRef.description: UserRef is the reference of the Authenticator's User

deviceRef.description: DeviceRef is the reference of the Authenticator's Device, if any

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the type of the Authenticator

info.description: Info is the type-specific information of the Authenticator

authenticationAttempt.description: AuthenticationAttempt is the currently pending authentication attempt

lastAuthenticationAttempts.description: LastAuthenticationAttempts is the list of the last authentication attempts

successfulAuthentications.description: SuccessfulAuthentications is the total number of the successful authentications via the Authenticator

failedAuthentications.description: FailedAuthentications is the total number of the failed authentications via the Authenticator

totalAuthenticationAttempts.description: TotalAuthenticationAttempts is the total number of the authentication attempts via the Authenticator

ext.description: Ext is a map of internal Cluster-managed extension data

isRegistered.description: IsRegistered indicates whether the Authenticator has completed its registration

description.description: Description is a human-readable description of the Authenticator

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..title: Status
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..description: Status is the current status of the Authenticator

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp at which the attempt was created

encryptedChallengeRequest.description: EncryptedChallengeRequest is the encrypted challenge that was issued for the attempt

encryptedDataMap.description: EncryptedDataMap is a map of the attempt's additional encrypted data

dataMap.description: DataMap is a map of the attempt's additional data

sessionRef.description: SessionRef is the reference of the Session that performed the attempt

completedAt.description: CompletedAt is the timestamp at which the attempt was completed

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..title: Authentication Attempt
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..description: AuthenticationAttempt is a single authentication attempt via the Authenticator

nonce.description: Nonce is the nonce used for the encryption

keySecretRef.description: KeySecretRef is the reference of the Secret containing the key that encrypted the value

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..title: Encrypted Data
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..description: EncryptedData is a value that is stored encrypted by the Cluster

fido.description: FIDO is the information of a FIDO/WebAuthn Authenticator

totp.description: TOTP is the information of a TOTP Authenticator

tpm.description: TPM is the information of a TPM 2.0 Authenticator

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..title: Info
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..description: Info is the type-specific information of the Authenticator

id.description: ID is the WebAuthn credential ID

publicKey.description: PublicKey is the credential's public key

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the attachment type of the FIDO Authenticator

aaguid.description: AAGUID is the Authenticator Attestation GUID that identifies the model of the Authenticator

isPasskey.description: IsPasskey means that the Authenticator is a Passkey (i.e. it uses a resident/discoverable key credential)

idHash.description: IDHash is the hash of the credential ID

backupEligible.description: BackupEligible means that the credential is eligible to be backed up and synced across the User's devices

isAttestationVerified.description: IsAttestationVerified means that the Authenticator's attestation was verified

isSoftware.description: IsSoftware means that the Authenticator is software-based (e.g. a password manager)

isHardware.description: IsHardware means that the Authenticator is hardware-backed (e.g. a security key or a platform authenticator)

signCount.description: SignCount is the credential's signature counter which is used to detect the cloned Authenticators

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..title: FIDO
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..description: FIDO is the information of a FIDO/WebAuthn Authenticator

sharedSecret.description: SharedSecret is the TOTP shared secret

periodSeconds.description: PeriodSeconds is the duration in seconds of a single time step

digits.description: Digits is the number of digits of the generated one-time passwords

algorithm.title: Algorithm
algorithm.description: Algorithm is the HMAC algorithm used to generate the one-time passwords

lastAcceptedTimeStep.description: LastAcceptedTimeStep is the last time step that was accepted. It is used to prevent replaying the same one-time password.

lastAcceptedAt.description: LastAcceptedAt is the timestamp at which a one-time password was last accepted

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..title: TOTP
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..description: TOTP is the information of a time-based one-time password (TOTP) Authenticator

akBytes.description: AKBytes is the TPM's attestation key

attestationParameters.description: AttestationParameters is the attestation of the TPM's attestation key

ekPublicKey.description: EKPublicKey is the public key of the TPM's endorsement key

endorsement.description: Endorsement is the provenance of the TPM's endorsement key

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..title: TPM
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..description: TPM is the information of a Trusted Platform Module (TPM) 2.0 Authenticator

public.description: Public is the public area of the attestation key

createData.description: CreateData is the creation data of the attestation key

createAttestation.description: CreateAttestation is the creation attestation of the attestation key

createSignature.description: CreateSignature is the creation signature of the attestation key

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..title: Attestation Parameters
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..description: AttestationParameters is the attestation of the TPM's attestation key

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: Verification is the outcome of the verification of the endorsement key certificate

certificateSHA256.description: CertificateSHA256 is the SHA256 digest of the DER-encoded endorsement key certificate

trustedCASHA256.description: TrustedCASHA256 is the SHA256 digest of the DER-encoded trusted CA that the endorsement key certificate chained to

manufacturerID.description: ManufacturerID is the TCG vendor identifier of the TPM manufacturer

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer is the human-readable name of the TPM manufacturer

model.description: Model is the model of the TPM

version.description: Version is the version of the TPM as stated by the endorsement key certificate. It is not the current firmware version of the TPM.

verifiedAt.description: VerifiedAt is the timestamp at which the verification was performed

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..title: Endorsement
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Authenticator..description: Endorsement is the provenance of the TPM's endorsement key as it was established upon registering the Authenticator

uid.description: UID is the unique UUID value for the object assigned by the Cluster. Read-only.

name.description: Name is the name of the object. It must be unique within a certain API/Version/Kind tuple.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation of the object. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp of when the object was last updated. Read-only.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the name that can be shown publicly for the object. Doesn't need to be unique.

description.description: Description is used to describe the object in a short sentence. Maximum characters are 1000.

labels.description: Labels is a map of string keys and values to organize objects.

tags.description: Tags is an optional array of tags that classify the Resource.

annotations.description: Annotations is a map of string keys and values that can be used to store arbitrary metadata about the object.

picURL.description: PicURL is the Picture URL of the resource.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is a unique ID that represent the current version of the resource object. Used by the Cluster to detect updates.

lastResourceVersion.description: LastResourceVersion is the ResourceVersion of the last update of the Resource.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the object reference to the Actor resource, typically a Session, who is responsible for the current resource change. If ActorRef is not set, then the current change of the resource was done by the Cluster

actorOperation.description: ActorOperation is the gRPC full method triggered by the actorRef to modify the Resource

isSystem.description: IsSystem means that the resource is created by the Cluster and it cannot be managed by the administrators. Read-only.

specLabels.description: SpecLabels is map used internally by the Cluster for quick searches among lists of objects. Read-only.

isUserHidden.description: IsUserHidden means that the resource object is hidden from ordinary Users and should not be exposed via the User APIs.

isSystemHidden.description: IsSystemHidden means that the resource object is hidden by the Cluster and should not be exposed via the APIs.

systemLabels.description: SystemLabels is a similar map to specLabels. Used only by the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.title: Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.description: Metadata is the metadata that is common to every Cluster resource. It carries the resource's identity (i.e. its UID and name), its human-readable information as well as the Cluster-managed bookkeeping of the resource's versioning and provenance.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
